interpretation.time: An estimate from wall through bestmove minus Forge's truncated-ms last depth time on capped searches, divided by total measured wall. Different clock origins and UCI/dispatch overhead also enter the estimate.
interpretation.cap: Flag exactly means final nodes exceed last completed depth nodes. The 8,000 node test is a consistency check.
interpretation.rule: At the final boundary test cap savings against n_d and n_(d-1). At the penultimate boundary test a false stop before the observed completed d using n_(d-1) and n_(d-2). Each boundary requires its own current snapshot below 2,000.
interpretation.literal_sensitivity: Restrict the false-stop test to searches where the actual final completed snapshot is also below 2,000.
interpretation.overlap: Report boundary outcomes separately and also exclude cap rows with an earlier observed false stop. No earlier boundary is reconstructed from the G1 TSV.
interpretation.upper_bound: Tail nodes saved in replay are a local upper bound because the skipped work leaves fewer hash entries for later searches, and changed moves can change subsequent positions.
